item.title: Naruto Movie Officially Casts Fan-favorite Actor for Key Role
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton is gearing up for his next live-action adaptation of an iconic franchise. He's writing and directing a live-action Naruto movie, and is in the process of casting an important role.

item.title: Steven Spielberg Officially Takes On a New Genre for Next Movie
item.description: Steven Spielberg is finally getting his chance to make a Western, and he's bringing some serious star power along for the ride. The legendary filmmaker is developing an adaptation of The Heart in Winter , with Jessie Buckley ( Hamnet ), Cillian Murphy ( Oppenheimer ), and Mark Rylance ( Bridge of Spies ) set to star.

item.title: GTA 6 Hacker Officially Walks Free After Judge's Final Warning
item.description: The man responsible for one of the biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is finally out of prison, and the judge had one very simple message for him: Don't do it again, mister.

item.title: Where to find the UFO dream house in GTA 6
item.description: If you're looking for the UFO dream house location in Grand Theft Auto 6 , that means you've already seen the UFO itself once. This unmarked optional mission begins when you investigate an abandoned car at the side of the road, follow a trail of clothes strewn on the floor, then discover a woman in a rather unfortunate situation, being beamed up into the sky. The next time you go to sleep, a concerning dream sequence happens, with one part of it showing somewhere in Leonida depicted onto what is supposed to be planet Earth.

item.title: Should you give the statue to Benedict Halifax during 'Dubious Provenance' in GTA 6?
item.description: Giving the statue to Halifax during the Grand Theft Auto 6 "Dubious Provenance" mission may not seem like the wisest choice, but don't be too quick to decide. In this GTA 6 mission, one choice is more rewarding and more time-efficient than the other.

item.title: What is the laptop password in GTA 6.
item.description: There's a laptop that needs a password in the bedroom of your Chapter 3 apartment in Grand Theft Auto 6 . When you try to use the laptop, you need to choose the password from a few different options, but none of the options seem right. As it turns out, you need to investigate around the apartment before the correct options appear. Luckily, the password is fairly close to you, and the laptop's contents will lead you to a worthy reward.

item.title: Where to find Auntie's Place in La Perle in GTA 6
item.description: Auntie's Place is a restaurant in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but it's also a clue to another location from the laptop in the Vice City apartment. Unfortunately, Auntie's Place is extremely difficult to find, as it's not marked on the map. All we know about Auntie's Place is that it's in La Perle, and La Perle is a fairly large region. However, you'll need to find it, as there's a hidden reward just beside it that is well worth your while.

item.title: GTA 6 Vice City Pre-Order DLC Now Available for All, With One Catch
item.description: Fans who pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto 6 prior to its Nov. 19 release were treated to a bundle of exclusive in-game goodies . If you bought the game after release day or just forgot to get your copy in advance, you sadly missed out on these bonuses. Rockstar Games, however, is now giving everyone a chance to grab the Vintage Vice City Pack regardless of when you bought the game. You will, of course, have to shell out some more money for it.

item.title: GTA 6’s Most Incredible Easter Egg Is 5 Years in the Making
item.description: It’s no secret that Grand Theft Auto 6 is absolutely massive , but one of the most impressive things about the game's world is how many secrets and strange occurrences are packed into its nooks and crannies. Players have already found bizarre secrets involving aliens, underwater monsters, Red Hulk, giant crabs, death games, unkillable stalkers, and, of course, the Skunk Ape . But beyond these strange finds, the game has an even more elaborate Easter egg, one set up five years ago with Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition .

item.title: Hunger Games' Breakout Star Rumored for New Six-Part Dystopian Sci-Fi Series
item.description: Francis Lawrence has a lot on his plate following the release of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping . The director, who has helmed five of six Hunger Games movies, is currently juggling a BioShock film , a possible sequel to 2005's Constantine , and an adaptation of the critically acclaimed novel Red Rising . That last one is of particular interest, given just how popular the dystopian sci-fi book series from author Pierce Brown is. Now it seems that Lawrence and Brown may have found the perfect person to join the adaptation's cast thanks to Sunrise on the Reaping .
